div.head: Wer 3
div.ab: 7 riht is, þæt se slaga, syððan he weres beweddod hæbbe, finde ðærto wærborh, be ðam ðe ðærto gebyrige: þæt is æt twelfhyndum were gebyriað XII men to werborge, VIII fæderenmægðe 7 IIII medrenmægðe.

Et rectum est, ut homicida, postquam weregildum mortui uadiauerit, inueniat wereplegios, sicut ad eam pertinebit: hoc est de ƿelfhindi hominis weregildo debent dari XII homines ad wereplegium, octo de cognatione patris et quatuor de cognatione matris.

7 riht is, ðæt se slaga, siððan he weres beweddod hæbbe, finde ðærto wærborh, be þam ðe ðærto gebyrige: ðæt is æt twelfhyndum were gebyriað twelf men to werborge, VIII fæderenmægðe 7 IIII medrenmægðe.

It is the law that the killer, after he has pledged the wergeld, should find wergeld-surety for it: that is for a twelve-hundred shilling wergeld, twelve men are appropriate as wergeld surety, eight from the paternal kin and four from the maternal.

Und richtig ist, dass der Totschläger, sobald er das Wergeld rechtsförmlich versprochen hat, dafür Wergeld-Bürgschaft stellt: d. h. bei 1200 [Schilling] Wergeld [des Erschlagenen] gebühren sich 12 Männer zur Wergeld-Bürgschaft, 8 der Vatersippe und 4 der Muttersippe [des Totschlägers].

And it is right that the slayer, as soon as he has formally pledged the wergild, should provide wergild-sureties for it: that is, for a wergild of 1200 [shillings, of the slain man] 12 men are due as wergild-sureties, 8 from the father's kin and 4 from the mother's kin [of the slayer].
